description:
Generate a random biodiversity survey dataset for Madagascar.

Starting with the loaded world countries map:
1. Select 'Madagascar' from the countries layer.
2. Use the 'Random points' geoprocessing tool (in the Sextante/Geoprocessing toolbox) to generate exactly 40 random points constrained to the selected feature.
3. Save the result as a new shapefile: '/home/ga/gvsig_data/exports/madagascar_survey.shp'.
4. Open the attribute table of the new layer and add two new Double/Float fields named 'LON' and 'LAT'.
5. Use the Field Calculator to populate these fields with the X (Longitude) and Y (Latitude) coordinates of each point.
6. Save your edits.
